request_text: Doc-alignment (S-A / #2722): reframe the ~6 canonical docs+skills that list 'templates' as a mission-type STRUCTURAL building block PEER to steps/phases/actions, so that a STEP is the building block and a template is an artefact a step carries/references. Grounded in ADR 2026-07-16-2 (D1/D2) + an occurrence census that found the word 'template' is already vocabulary-clean everywhere else. NOT a word-swap and NOT a full mission; prose-only, invariance-preserving (DRG must stay fresh at 280/757/10). Targets: src/doctrine/skills/spec-kitty-mission-system/SKILL.md, docs/architecture/mission-system.md, docs/guides/switch-missions.md, src/doctrine/missions/README.md, docs/context/orchestration.md.
